items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The old lady. That's been about three years since I saw her. She still had his horn.

ctx.x: It was still over in the project. Not far from where it is. The old man?

The old lady. That's been about three years since I saw her. She still had his horn. A little short con. Cornet. I got an E flat. I think she's giving it to the museum maybe. I got an E flat conet too.
